table.finding: Third/fourth-view edges now exist (2020: 16-18 views, 2022: 19-22 views) but edge fits are 2.95-3.7 px RMS (> 2 px) and the two epochs disagree with each other (right edge 0.17-0.30 u vs 0.27-0.36 u from March; left edge 1.85 u vs 0.73-0.79 u: forward-walking views make edge depth ill-conditioned). Segment face planes of both epochs sit 0.11 (2020) / 0.14 u (2022) on the plaza side of the March plane, <20% within 0.05 u. Same dark grey panelled pier with small signs is visible in 2020-11, 2022-12 and 2026-03: architecture stable (pixel-level). Not confirmed, not contradicted at class-a level.

Red doors, rear window and blue notice identical in 2020/2022/2023/2026 (pixel-level). 2020 segment plane lies 0.11 u deeper (+V) than March, 1.8 deg rotated; only 25% of 2020 (21% of 2022) points within 0.05 u of the March plane.

Too few 2020 points (11); 2022 points (235) sit ~0.26 u in front of the March plane ([INFERENCE] free-standing signs/furniture in front of the panels in the crowded 2022 walk) - not a wall measurement.

2020: 29 points, median 0.36 u from the March plane, 0% within 0.05 u; the March plane (normal Y -0.56, i.e. tilted 34 deg) is not supported by independent points - consistent with a reflection-driven March fit, but the independent data do not form a class-a plane either. 2022: 2 points.
Independent points 0.19 u (2020) / 0.24 u (2022) median from the March plane, no coherent segment plane (segment fits 70+ deg off): glass balustrade, reflection-dominated.
No independent point in the supported box in either epoch (the corridor walks turn onto the escalator before this face is resolved).

2022 edge meets every class-a edge number (39 views, 14.1 deg, 1.31 px fit RMS, 0.84 px held-out median) but its registration is rejected. Both epochs place the lip 0.18-0.28 u (2022) / 0.09-0.46 u (2020) toward -U of the March first-view line and within 0.14 u (both epochs) of the March HELD-OUT view 000140 intersections (20.050,-17.034) / (19.758,-15.437): the independent views side with the March held-out view, i.e. the March first-view line is the likelier outlier. Still no opening polygon; do not cut the slab.
Inventory search ROI (U 20-22.6, V -20.2..-18.5) holds 0 (2020) / 6 (2022) quality points; the face is not resolved by these walks.

New measurable member of the stainless panel-clad box family: front face of the box left of the red office doors. 2020 and 2022 independently give the same face (V -15.036 vs -15.001 at U 13, yaw 9.4 vs 9.7 deg; 2020: 174 inliers, 0.016 u RMS, 72% held-out within 0.05 u; 2022: 11 inliers, 76%). Held-out fraction < 0.85 and registration rejected -> not class a. This box explains the unmodelled cluster (U 12-14, V -16..-15, Y~1.85) that failed the low-ceiling p95 check.
Not in view: the 환공어묵 / core-B side (U -8..-2) is outside every corridor sightline of the three segments.
Elevator doors not in view; only the "엘리베이터" direction signs on the stainless band at the corridor end (2020, 2022, 2026).
Elevator doors not in view (see vc-core-A).

#3 frontage is an open glazed B&C DONUT shop in 2022-12 and 2023-10 versus the 2026-03 hoarding: tenant-state change (identity from the 2026-08 board, not from these videos). Partition edge not triangulated.

#4 glazing line on the inbound right: DESIGN SKIN fascia in 2020-11 and 2023-10 (and "DESI.." in 2022-12 per triage) versus ARTBOX in 2026; glazing mullions are the parallel lines that confuse the pier left-edge search. Not measured.

Epochs disagree: best vertical V-facing plane at V~-39.6 (2020) vs V~-36.1 (2022, 13 inliers); held-out medians 1.1 / 4.0 u -> the ROI mixes door leaves, frames and lobby structure. Glass doors give too few stable points.

Flight footprint not measured: the escalator-ride sub-models (S20 123-158 s, S22 243-285 s) could only be chained through shared frames and those chains fail held-out (shared camera centres 0.30 u / 0.92 u apart, plumb 4.5 / 46 deg); S23 descent is in a rejected registration. Pixel-level: barrier gates with green indicators stand at the foot in 2020, 2022 and 2026. The 2F slab opening remains unmeasured.
